transactions.shows: a fund posts sBILL as margin
a trade opens at the Chainlink price
settlement pays the winner through the vault, with funding
the vault redeems its sBILL and keeps the discount
a liquidation pays the winner and the liquidator through the vault

features.feature: Gas measured, with a change made because of it
Chainlink feed with staleness and sign checks
Liquidation with a reward for the liquidator, plus a keeper
Weekend vault and calendar-aware margin (our own addition)
